For teachers and tutors

About Test Yourself: Speaking

An adaptive check of the language learners need to speak: answering everyday questions, choosing question words, replying to greetings and putting a sentence in order. It draws on the Speaking Game, Question Words, Listen and Unscramble and Greetings.

How to play

  1. Answer each round.
  2. The test changes to match you.
  3. See your results.

Play it as a class

Students take it on their own phones, then follow up with real speaking in pairs.
